chunks: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

If he has not yet entered into her, and he has already designated a dowry for her, then she is entitled to half of what he designated for her, and she inherits, and she must observe the waiting period.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a wife if her husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: In the Shia jurisprudential tradition, this ruling from al-Istibsar clarifies that full marital status is recognized even before consummation, granting the widow both inheritance rights and the obligation of iddah. This distinguishes the case from a mere betrothal, ensuring the wife receives half the specified mahr while maintaining her legal standing as a spouse.
